title: No easy way out: dissecting firm heterogeneity to enhance default risk prediction
core_idea: Investigate how firm-level heterogeneity (industry, technological level, size, age) affects the predictive strength of financial indicators (liquidity, efficiency, profitability, growth) for firm default risk, using logistic regression and random forests on a large sample of Italian firms to evaluate the need for tailored prediction approaches.
tldr: Explores whether and how firm characteristics change which financial indicators best predict default risk, applying statistical and machine-learning methods to a large sample of Italian firms.
